description.value: Mag's 99 is a vibrant fusion restaurant in Squamish that marries Mexican cantina staples — burritos, chimichangas, tacos, and enchiladas — with signature crispy fried chicken and loaded poutines, earning a loyal local following for its generous portions and fast service. The restaurant is an established presence in the Sea-to-Sky corridor and is actively expanding via a franchise model. Touring cyclists will find a broad comfort-food menu with clearly marked vegetarian and gluten-free options well-suited for refuelling after rides.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at magssquamish.com confirms an active Mexican-fried chicken fusion restaurant at 1257 Commercial Way #5, Squamish — OSM omits the '#5' unit number and lists no phone, while the website consistently shows (604) 657-6247 across all pages. The menu explicitly marks vegetarian (V) and gluten-free (GF) items, and the prominent 'Order Online' feature plus a customer review referencing an online 18-piece meal order confirm takeout availability. No website evidence exists for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any cycling-specific infrastructure amenities.
